title: Bridge Round 6 Picks
eyebrow: GPOM · the bridge · timeline round 5 notes
heading: Maddie's aside, the old lady's hum, and the horn hanging down
intro: From your timeline round 5 notes. Pick one per row. Nothing is spent until you pick. The voices were checked by the speech checker only; nobody has listened.

groups.title: Maddie: "…And everything else."
groups.line: Ten readings of subdued, apologetic, serious and regretful, all in her voice and through the tannoy as in the film. The first one is what's in the cut now.

opts.label: now (round 5): the straight punchline
1: confession: a quiet confession, barely above a murmur, as the full weight of what she means finally lands on her
2: catch: she stops, a catch in the throat, then says it: owning the enormous thing behind the small words
3: verdict: flat and plain, no performance at all, like reading out a verdict against herself
4: owning up: small and ashamed, like a child owning up to something far too big to fix
5: careful: slow and heavy, each word set down carefully, as if it might break
6: understatement: rueful, knowing the words are absurdly too small for what happened, saying them softly anyway
7: mourner: grief in it: a mourner speaking at a funeral she herself caused
8: formal: a formal, dignified apology she truly means; measured and grave, nothing cute about it
9: exhale: a long breath out first, then the words carried almost on that breath, sad and tired
10: tender: gentle and sincere, warm with regret, as if to someone she hurt and still cares about

groups.title: The old lady: "Hmm…" before "Perhaps we should vote."
groups.line: Her own voice, thinking before she speaks. It goes over her closed mouth, so it doesn't need a new clip.
